scope: Independent source and visual critique of upgraded minimap and expanded map for all four mine/Depth biomes and The Deep; preservation of approved surrounding art.
verdict: Approved for the requested map upgrade: 8.4/10 after three rounds. Final Mac browser and ordinary WebKit gates completed; no remaining map release blocker identified.

findings: Discovery filter followed an early 128-marker truncation.
Meaningful live-excavation evidence was still missing.
Save sanitizer silently truncated exploration at 100000 cells.
Discovery now precedes entrance-first, nearest-first marker cap.
Actual bent excavation corridor is clearly reflected in both map scales.
Exploration survives streamed coordinate rebasing and save restoration; destructive cell cap removed.
Final Mac captures visibly confirm terrain expansion after actual touch mining and identical expanded geometry after restore.
All 40 browser checks pass, including map touch interaction, live excavation, paused save/reload and runtime error gate.
Ordinary WebKit startup completes on Apple GPU; input release and 414 core checks pass.
Publication script binds accepted bytes to reviewed evidence and validates protected LIVE/Worn hashes.

mac_browser_partial.status: Partial; harness stopped at missing mine button lookup before browser mining checks.

mac_browser_final.renderer: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple Paravirtual device, Unspecified Version)

publisher_review.finding: Accepted manifest and reviewed-file hash binding, immutable artifact/run validation, candidate identity check, protected LIVE/Worn byte preservation, and 27-file public verification implemented. Publication success itself must be confirmed by receipt.

strengths: Actual traversable geometry and visible boundary walls replace empty rectangular diagrams.
Local minimap maintains useful scale while expanded view fits explored geometry.
Distinct player, ore, entrance and objective symbols with complete legend.
Shared cached terrain data avoids independent map drift and bounded discovery cannot see through walls.
Approved frame, character and surrounding artwork preserved.
limitations: No direct physical iPhone Safari performance measurement reviewed; Apple Metal browser evidence is not equivalent.
Very large explored areas can become small in expanded fit-to-bounds view; zoom/pan is not implemented.
Deep expanded map displays the currently loaded terrain window; retained exploration outside it is not an all-depth atlas.
Exploration storage scales with explored cells; extreme-session memory and save latency are not established by these checks.
